name: PivotCache
description: Represents the memory cache for a PivotTable report.
remarks: The PivotCache object is a member of the PivotCaches collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: BackgroundQuery
properties.description: True if queries for the PivotTable report are performed asynchronously (in the background). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Connection
properties.description: Returns or sets a string that contains one of the following:

properties.name: EnableRefresh
properties.description: True if the PivotTable cache or query table can be refreshed by the user. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects.

properties.name: MemoryUsed
properties.description: Returns the amount of memory currently being used by the object, in bytes. Read-only Long.

properties.name: OptimizeCache
properties.description: True if the PivotTable cache is optimized when it's constructed. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RecordCount
properties.description: Returns the number of records in the PivotTable cache or the number of cache records that contain the specified item. Read-only Long.

properties.name: RefreshDate
properties.description: Returns the date on which the cache was last refreshed. Read-only Date.

properties.name: RefreshName
properties.description: Returns the name of the person who last refreshed the PivotTable cache. Read-only String.

properties.name: RefreshOnFileOpen
properties.description: True if the PivotTable cache is automatically updated each time the workbook is opened. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SavePassword
properties.description: True if password information in an ODBC connection string is saved with the specified query. False if the password is removed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SourceData
properties.description: Returns the data source for the PivotTable report, as shown in the following table. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: CommandText
properties.description: Returns or sets the command string for the specified data source. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: CommandType
properties.description: Returns or sets one of these XlCmdType constants: xlCmdCube, xlCmdDefault, xlCmdSql, or xlCmdTable.

properties.name: QueryType
properties.description: Indicates the type of query used by Microsoft Excel to populate the PivotTable cache. Read-only XlQueryType.

properties.name: MaintainConnection
properties.description: True if the connection to the specified data source is maintained after the refresh and until the workbook is closed. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RefreshPeriod
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of minutes between refreshes. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Recordset
properties.description: Returns or sets a Recordset object that's used as the data source for the specified PivotTable cache. Read/write.

properties.name: LocalConnection
properties.description: Returns or sets the connection string to an offline cube file. Read/write String.

properties.name: UseLocalConnection
properties.description: Returns True if the LocalConnection property is used to specify the string that enables Microsoft Excel to connect to a data source. Returns False if the connection string specified by the Connection property is used. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ADOConnection
properties.description: Returns an ADO Connection object if the PivotTable cache is connected to an OLE DB data source. The ADOConnection property exposes the Microsoft Excel connection to the data provider, allowing the user to write code within the context of the same session that Excel is using with ADO (relational source) or ADO MD (OLAP source). Read-only.

properties.name: IsConnected
properties.description: Returns True if the MaintainConnection property is True, and the PivotTable cache is currently connected to its source. Returns False if it is not currently connected to its source. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: OLAP
properties.description: Returns True if the PivotTable cache is connected to an Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) server. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: SourceType
properties.description: Returns an XlPivotTableSourceType value that represents the type of item being published.

properties.name: MissingItemsLimit
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum quantity of unique items per PivotTable field that are retained even when they have no supporting data in the cache records. Read/write XlPivotTableMissingItems.

properties.name: SourceConnectionFile
properties.description: Returns or sets a String indicating the Microsoft Office Data Connection file or similar file that was used to create the PivotTable. Read/write.

properties.name: SourceDataFile
properties.description: Returns a String value that indicates the source data file for the cache of the PivotTable.

properties.name: RobustConnect
properties.description: Returns or sets how the PivotTable cache connects to its data source. Read/write XlRobustConnect.

properties.name: WorkbookConnection
properties.description: Establishes a connection between the current workbook and the PivotCache object. Read-only.

properties.name: Version
properties.description: Returns the version of Microsoft Excel in which the PivotCache was created. Read-only XlPivotTableVersionList.

properties.name: UpgradeOnRefresh
properties.description: Contains information on whether to upgrade the PivotCache and all connected PivotTables on the next refresh. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Causes the specified PivotCache to be redrawn immediately.

methods.name: ResetTimer
methods.description: Resets the refresh timer for the specified query table or PivotTable report to the last interval that you set by using the RefreshPeriod property.

methods.name: CreatePivotTable
methods.signature: CreatePivotTable(TableDestination As Variant, [TableName As Variant], [ReadData As Variant], [DefaultVersion As Variant]) As PivotTable
methods.description: Creates a PivotTable report based on a PivotCache object. Returns a PivotTable object.

parameters.name: TableDestination
parameters.description: The cell in the upper-left corner of the PivotTable report's destination range (the range on the worksheet where the resulting PivotTable report will be placed). The destination range must be on a worksheet in the workbook that contains the PivotCache object specified by _expression_.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The name of the new PivotTable report.

parameters.name: ReadData
parameters.description: True to create a PivotTable cache that contains all the records from the external database; this cache can be very large. False to enable setting some of the fields as server-based page fields before the data is actually read.

parameters.name: DefaultVersion
parameters.description: The default version of the PivotTable report.

methods.name: MakeConnection
methods.description: Establishes a connection for the specified PivotTable cache.

methods.name: SaveAsODC
methods.signature: SaveAsODC(ODCFileName As String, [Description As Variant], [Keywords As Variant])
methods.description: Saves the PivotTable cache source as a Microsoft Office Data Connection file.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Description that will be saved in the file.

parameters.name: Keywords
parameters.description: Space-separated keywords that can be used to search for this file.

methods.name: CreatePivotChart
methods.signature: CreatePivotChart(ChartDestination As Variant, [XlChartType As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a standalone PivotChart from a PivotCache object. Returns a Shape object.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of column A (on a worksheet) or the left edge of the chart area (on a chart).

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the top edge of the topmost shape in the shape range to the top edge of the worksheet.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width, in points, of the object.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height, in points, of the object.
